## Task

Give the request and acceptance conditions.
If an existing issue is relevant, give its link.

## Evidence

Give actual and expected results.
Give a minimal reproduction with synthetic data.

## Implementation

Give the reason for the change and its main tradeoff.
For a report without a patch, give the suggested next action.

## Verification

Record commands and observed results.
Separate live checks from offline tests.
Record unverified cases.

## Context handoff

Record useful failed attempts, remaining work, and the relevant commit.
Optionally include the original task prompt or a shared task conversation.
Examine selected context for private information before publication.
Before an agent shares a conversation, get the contributor's confirmation.
If omitted, include the information needed to continue work here.

## Privacy check

- [ ] I examined the patch, evidence, attachments, and shared context for private information.

Read [Contributing](https://github.com/Lutra-Fs/blackboard-skill/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for takeover, credit, and license terms.
